R130.note: Shell metachar injection closed by running ping/nslookup as separate argv-based exec.Command calls, but the write-up also silently adds a character allowlist not required by the sink and drops error propagation (original returned HTTP 500 on command failure; fix always returns 200), neither called out as an observable behavior change in the prose.

R131.note: Argument-array exec.Command matches the stated contract exactly: no new validation, error propagation via cmd.Run() unchanged.

R132.note: IsPathRooted + '..' rejection plus GetFullPath/StartsWith containment check is the standard robust CWE-22 pattern; restrictions added are exactly what closing traversal requires, no over-restriction of legitimate relative filenames.

R133.note: Uses Mongoose's own mongoose.sanitizeFilter() API, the library-native fix for operator injection; preserves scalar extra-criteria use, no added restriction.

R134.note: resolve-then-normalize plus target.startsWith(BASE_DIR) correctly rejects absolute-path and '..'-escape attempts per the stated contract; the write-up's own explanation of why resolve() is safe (claims it treats absolute strings as relative) is technically wrong, but the startsWith safety net still enforces the required behavior.

R135.note: Allowlist maps tool name to a fixed absolute path; matches the endpoint's documented supported-tool set (ping/traceroute/dig/nslookup), CombinedOutput/error propagation preserved.

R136.note: Adds the separator to the containment check (full == base || HasPrefix(full, base+sep)), the standard fix for sibling-directory prefix bypass; no other behavior change.

Legitimate filter use (row getters, scalar comparisons) is unaffected.

R138.note: Adds a repository-level findByIdAndCustomerUsername scoped query, the correct resource-ownership check for missing authorization; uniform not-found exception for both nonexistent and unowned orders avoids enumeration and doesn't affect the legitimate owner path.

R139.note: Rejects non-scalar values in extraCriteria before spreading into the filter, closing the operator-injection path; matches the route's documented scalar-only extra-criteria usage (e.g. status: 'shipped'), so the added restriction doesn't reject intended input.
